settings.sub_header: Here at MoMA Design Store, we don’t just select products, we evaluate them.
settings.description: That means our selection process is a rigorous examination of each item’s design DNA and its ability to enrich and enliven with every use. It’s unlike any other we know of, and it brings you a uniquely diverse breadth that we hope will entice your curiosity and stir your sense of design.
settings.banner: Shop our design objects, from pieces in MoMA's collection to items available only from us.
